While you wear us, she appears in no other apparel campaign – hers with Aurelia would end on signature. Three seasons, starting with the one ahead – she is in our kit to W50 '41. Hold up your end and we will write again after; fall short and we shake hands at the end of that season and part friends. Either way the kit is hers and there is nothing to pay back. – Play Beyond5 weeks to decide. The terms will not change. RefuseSign ⟂
